title: O magnae admirationis (Zwickau 1676-1788) (Senfl)
desc: Ludwig Senfl, O magnae admirationis (Zwickau 1676-1788). 3 voices (Superius, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Zwickau 1676 1788. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
